primary_metrics.average_tpot_s: (last Increment completion - first Increment completion)/(output_tokens-1); None when output_tokens=1
primary_metrics.joint_pass: TTFT <= threshold AND (m=1 OR average_TPOT <= threshold)
primary_metrics.required: ceil(Decimal(str(target))*N); empty workload has undefined attainment and safe=None

runtime.q_role: KV/context upper bound and diagnostic boundaries only
runtime.Q_P: sum full input_tokens over active Prefill cohort
runtime.singleton: Pinned linear lookup at N=1, then multiply decode by 2; N=0 is zero
runtime.batch_charge: Each stage batch cost once per round; diagnostic shares never affect progress
runtime.network: Each boundary message once per routed physical link; sum activation_bytes_per_token*(Q_P+N_D) over boundaries using that link, divide by effective link capacity
runtime.composition: T_round=sum stage costs+sum link serialization; mu=1/T_round
runtime.progress: dp/dt=mu; dg/dt=mu; retain fractional progress on state changes
runtime.ties: Atomic completion/phase/block transitions and arrivals at same timestamp, then resource check and rate recomputation
runtime.tie_tolerance_s: max(1e-12,8*ulp(timestamp)) for computed completion ties; arrivals admitted when arrival<=timestamp
runtime.memory: Weights+workspace+reserve+KV+per-stage activation buffers; independent hard gate, no slowdown; zero-layer nodes retain historical zero workspace/reserve policy
runtime.context: Prefill=input; Decode=input+min((block+1)*q,output_tokens); advance block at q multiples
runtime.domain: No extrapolation, tiling, clamping or fitting. Unsupported profile/hardware => unsupported_profile_domain, safe=None
runtime.resource_failure: hard_resource_infeasible for memory excess or positive traffic over zero capacity; safe=False, latency attainment/counts undefined

migration.average_tpot_s: mean(decode_tpot_s[1:] - record overhead), None for one output
migration.final_completion: arrival + reconstructed TTFT + sum(decode_tpot_s[1:] - overhead); max request final equals saved raw.final_time_s
migration.identity: Canonical physical inputs without SLA/accounting metadata; verify recovered aliases before deduplication
migration.failure: Retain unsupported/migration_failed with reasons; never infer missing data or rerun reference

validation.benchmark: Small deterministic workloads only; CPU planning runtime, not GPU serving speedup

publication: Withdrawn unpublished AICCC is not prior publication. Accepted Evaluator-Guided SLA-Aware Layer Partitioning for Heterogeneous LLM Pipelines is prior work. Evaluator-induced capacity, predefined family, evaluator-guided comparison and coarse-to-fine search are not new journal contributions.
stop: Implementation, tests, read-only cache audit, report, status/log, commit/push, HEAD==origin/main and clean tree. No formal matrix or manuscript.
